{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Imperial_Operative.jpg|thumb|250px|right|A [[Human/Legends|Human]] Operative in conversation with a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] informant]]
{{Quote|When you least expect it, one of these operatives will show up and probably save your life.|[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]|<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>}}
'''Operatives''' were [[Spy/Legends|spies]] responsible for providing information, equipments or goods to a faction. While the term could refer to specialized combat troops, some operatives were non-combatants who used stealth or subterfuge to infiltrate a target. Some operatives worked in support services or were employees of corporations which supply ships or weapons. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] used operatives on several [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].

==History==
[[File:Varena_Talos_IA-RtH.png|thumb|left|200px|Verena Talos, a Rebel operative]]
During the years of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed it circa [[3653 BBY]], the term "operative" was used to refer to a specific breed of [[Imperial Agent]].<ref name="Holonet-Imperial Agent">{{Holonet|classes|imperial-agent|Imperial Agent}}</ref> These operatives served the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and were combat capable. They were known for wielding [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and [[Energy sword|energy blades]], and utilized [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generators]].<ref name="FanFriday">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100820-0|text=STAR WARS: The Old Republic Fan Friday (August 20, 2010)|nolive=1}}</ref>

After the [[Defense of Ralltiir|Battle of Ralltiir]] where Alliance [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] participated in the defense of the planet from the Empire, many of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir's]] population felt indebted to the Rebellion and became operatives.<ref name="Card-CCG-Ralltiir Operative">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Ralltiir Operative}}</ref>

On [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], Imperials used hunters who tracked down escaped [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] slaves and reported their location. The Empire and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] paid a high price for that kind of information. Alternatively, following the subjugation of Kashyyyk by the Empire, the Alliance hired merchants to purchase Wookiee slaves to be freed.<ref name="Card-CCG-Kashyyyk_Operative_Dark">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Kashyyyk_Operative_(Dark)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The operative is an advanced class for the Imperial agent class in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' MMO video game. This advanced class specializes in [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rifles, stealth, energy blades, and dealing bursts of damage in battle. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] counterpart for this archetype is the [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]].<ref name="FanFriday" />
